headline: CORDAE'S ALBUM AT RISK?
deck: MMMG's New York federal suit alleges Cordae's 2018 deal still controls his recordings and seeks to block Heavy Is the Crown before its October 23 release. The complaint names EMPIRE, Apeshit and Mass Appeal; no injunction has been granted.

headline: LIL BABY SETS FRESH
deck: Lil Baby sets Fresh for November 6 with 17 teased songs, including Future and Young Thug on “All My Patnas” and Rylo Rodriguez on “In Your Head.” The rollout gives the Atlanta rapper's next era a confirmed date.

headline: GUCCI STAYS AGAINST ALL ODDS
deck: Against All Odds is Gucci Mane's 17-track, 18th studio album, released October 16 through 1017/Atlantic. Summer Walker, OJ da Juiceman and Ice Davis guest on the veteran's latest Atlanta trap chapter.

headline: Q WILL NEVER RETIRE
deck: ScHoolboy Q says his 12-song THank Que is coming in 2027 after he revived the project during the Blank Face LP anniversary tour. The TDE veteran also told fans he will never retire.

headline: ROCKSTAR REWRITES THE RULES
deck: Rockstar says GTA VI's team changed its work culture after Red Dead Redemption 2's crunch. Extra hours can mean paid time off or added pay, and the build is still being tuned for November 19.
